items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You must have heard of that name, Chaffray? I'm not sure. [INTERVIEWER] Maybe.

ctx.x: In French. In French. Well, you see, when I was working at Mrs. King, they had...it wasn't a school. It was just like you're nice, convoicing you. Yes. They had Mr. Chaffray. You must have heard of that name, Chaffray? I'm not sure.
